mapper.sql: stock_levels.id AS id, stock_levels.name AS name, stock_levels.price_type_id AS priceTypeId, price_types.name AS priceTypeName, stock_levels.is_active AS isActive, stock_levels.created AS created, CONCAT(users1.first_name, ' ', users1.last_name) AS createdBy, stock_levels.modified AS modified, CONCAT(users2.first_name, ' ', users2.last_name) AS modifiedBy

FROM stock_levels LEFT JOIN price_types ON price_types.id = stock_levels.price_type_id LEFT JOIN users AS users1 ON users1.id = stock_levels.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS users2 ON users2.id = stock_levels.modified_by

WHERE stock_levels.is_active = 1
AND ( stock_levels.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter.searchText}, '%') OR price_types.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter.searchText}, '%') )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_levels ( name, price_type_id, created, created_by, is_active ) VALUES ( #{stockLevel.name}, #{stockLevel.priceTypeId}, NOW(), #{stockLevel.createdBy}, #{stockLevel.isActive} )
